theory.equations: Pr=Pt*Gt/(4*pi*Rt^2)*sigma/(4*pi*Rr^2)*Gr*lambda^2/(4*pi*L); coherent energy SNR=Pr*t/(k*T*F). Finite aperture Fourier gain, physical range/Doppler bins, CFAR and temporal association. ARH uses its own transmitter and finite terminal eclipse/measurement lifecycle.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Finite detector/exposure or range/Doppler cells; no resampling of future scene or truth-based association.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

parameter_matrix.implicit_policy: Explicit native software constants and derived geometry are labelled separately from original card records. No assumed source flag is promoted.
parameter_matrix.correlations: Original per-parameter screening uncertainties are retained; covariance/correlation and equipment confidence coverage are unknown, so no independent-error aggregation is claimed.
parameter_matrix.identical_policy_meaning: These models currently reuse the same numerical engineering policy; that equality does not establish identical hardware, separate equipment tuning or calibrated per-model fidelity.
parameter_matrix.active_binding_note: All referenced records are preserved for exact descriptor hashing; retained scalar/compatibility roles do not establish additional active hardware. The selected receiver/mechanism bindings determine which numerical paths execute.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: Pr=Pt*Gt/(4*pi*Rt^2)*sigma/(4*pi*Rr^2)*Gr*lambda^2/(4*pi*L); coherent energy SNR=Pr*t/(k*T*F). Finite aperture Fourier gain, physical range/Doppler bins, CFAR and temporal association. ARH uses its own transmitter and finite terminal eclipse/measurement lifecycle.

sensitivity.limit: Resolved finite patches use actual solid angle, not an unconditional inverse-square shortcut.
Separate bistatic Rt/Rr and losses for SARH; no added acquisition-range multiplier.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: Exact selected receiver binding matters: old thermal_quadrant.v1 compatibility results do not verify thermal_conscan_reticle.v1.

Reticle mask, scalar capacitance/noise-area inference, stop/scan radius and scan law are engineering assumptions for these AAM variants, including Magic2 with a different historical multi-element description.
MICAIR dual-band discrimination and imaging clutter association require their own parameterized actual outputs; one common Planck equation pass is insufficient.

Navigation/measurement epoch error, eclipse, false image/waveform fits, clutter/flare contamination and unresolved angular rates can break the coupled chain despite correct static photon/RF arithmetic.

derived_geometry.source_geometry: finite sampled annulus in scene emitter; exact inner radius for V2, thin-wall inferred inner radius for V0

theory.equations: M=(1-s)*(W-C); D=ratio*missileD; L=(C/rhoC+M/rhoCase+s*(W-C)/rhoS)/(pi*(D/2)^2); v=1000*G/sqrt(M/C+1/2). V2 exact annulus: ri^2=ro^2-M/(rhoCase*pi*L); t=(ro^2-ri^2)/(ro+ri); N=round(M/(rhoCase*t^3)); emitted mi=M/N. Zone selection is a mixture with uniform cosine inside each selected band, not uniform polar angle.
theory.states: One emitted field, stable source ordinals, material age, point/rod endpoint positions and velocities, connected-unfolding age until breakup, per-victim crossing history.
theory.inputs: This exact card charge/case/Gurney data, captured burst pose/velocity/spin and RNG; native moving target geometry/material/environment.
theory.outputs: Finite point/rod population, remaining energy/momentum, skin/component work and source-attributed native damage; no hit probability scalar.
theory.discretization: Integer equivalent fragment count; rigid captured source transform; native chronological material crossings and continuation. Angular zones overlap where authored. Spatial/temporal convergence is separate from parameter calibration.

parameter_matrix.implicit_policy: Explicit native software constants and derived geometry are labelled separately from original card records. No assumed source flag is promoted.
parameter_matrix.correlations: Original per-parameter screening uncertainties are retained; covariance/correlation and equipment confidence coverage are unknown, so no independent-error aggregation is claimed.
parameter_matrix.identical_policy_meaning: No other current model in this family has this complete numeric policy and mechanism/receiver binding.
parameter_matrix.active_binding_note: All referenced records are preserved for exact descriptor hashing; retained scalar/compatibility roles do not establish additional active hardware. The selected receiver/mechanism bindings determine which numerical paths execute.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: M=(1-s)*(W-C); D=ratio*missileD; L=(C/rhoC+M/rhoCase+s*(W-C)/rhoS)/(pi*(D/2)^2); v=1000*G/sqrt(M/C+1/2). V2 exact annulus: ri^2=ro^2-M/(rhoCase*pi*L); t=(ro^2-ri^2)/(ro+ri); N=round(M/(rhoCase*t^3)); emitted mi=M/N. Zone selection is a mixture with uniform cosine inside each selected band, not uniform polar angle.
assumptions_and_theory_gap: Case partition15%, diameter90%, steel density and equivalent shape are generic assumptions for V0; descriptor refs do not expose these as per-model measured inputs.
V2 finite station/densities/Cd and seven angular shares are explicit, with game-reference zones and inferred geometry; not a measured C7 fragment distribution.
THOR steel-fragment/2024-T3 plate law is not DU/titanium/composite physics; connected topology is selected only by connected_ring.v1.
Blast TNT equivalence differs from fragment-driving energy; legacy equivalence is inferred from Gurney, V2 has a separate explicit TNT record.

theory.equations: Pr=Pt*Gt/(4*pi*Rt^2)*sigma/(4*pi*Rr^2)*Gr*lambda^2/(4*pi*L); coherent energy SNR=Pr*t/(k*T*F). Finite aperture Fourier gain, physical range/Doppler bins, CFAR and temporal association. SARH additionally requires actual separate illumination and pulse/PRF coincidence.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: Pr=Pt*Gt/(4*pi*Rt^2)*sigma/(4*pi*Rr^2)*Gr*lambda^2/(4*pi*L); coherent energy SNR=Pr*t/(k*T*F). Finite aperture Fourier gain, physical range/Doppler bins, CFAR and temporal association. SARH additionally requires actual separate illumination and pulse/PRF coincidence.

sensitivity.limit: Resolved finite patches use actual solid angle, not an unconditional inverse-square shortcut.
Separate bistatic Rt/Rr and losses for SARH; no added acquisition-range multiplier.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: Exact selected receiver binding matters: old thermal_quadrant.v1 compatibility results do not verify thermal_conscan_reticle.v1.

MICAIR dual-band discrimination and imaging clutter association require their own parameterized actual outputs; one common Planck equation pass is insufficient.

Navigation/measurement epoch error, eclipse, false image/waveform fits, clutter/flare contamination and unresolved angular rates can break the coupled chain despite correct static photon/RF arithmetic.

theory.equations: L_lambda=epsilon*2*h*c^2/(lambda^5*expm1(h*c/(lambda*k*T))); Q=integral(Lband*dOmega)*A*t*tau*QE*lambda_eff/(h*c). Reticle q=u+r*(cos(phi),sin(phi)); T=1[|q|<=R]*1[cos(n*atan2(qy,qx))>=0]; sum transmitted photons into ONE scalar channel, pole alpha=1-exp(-elapsed/tau), measured-waveform nuisance projection and finite template fit.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Whole phase-zero reticle scans; midpoint measurement epoch, read-ready after scan end plus processing delay. One resolved bearing never grants LOS rate.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. theory.equations: L_lambda=epsilon*2*h*c^2/(lambda^5*expm1(h*c/(lambda*k*T))); Q=integral(Lband*dOmega)*A*t*tau*QE*lambda_eff/(h*c). Finite imaging pixels/PSF, charge noise/ADC, background contrast and segmentation followed by measured feature association.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Finite detector/exposure or range/Doppler cells; no resampling of future scene or truth-based association.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.
theory.delta: aim-9x: thermal_image.v1; acquire_m=13000, gimbal_deg=45, sample_period_s=0.02, processing_delay_s=0.01, field_half_angle_rad=0.12, angle_noise_rad=0.0004, track_memory_s=0.12, ir_band_low_um=3, ir_band_high_um=5, receiver_pixel_pitch_rad=0.0015, receiver_psf_sigma_rad=0.00075, receiver_integration_s=1e-05, receiver_aperture_area_m2=0.0007917304360898403, receiver_quantum_efficiency=0.6. theory.equations: L_lambda=epsilon*2*h*c^2/(lambda^5*expm1(h*c/(lambda*k*T))); Q=integral(Lband*dOmega)*A*t*tau*QE*lambda_eff/(h*c). Finite imaging pixels/PSF, charge noise/ADC, background contrast and segmentation followed by measured feature association.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Finite detector/exposure or range/Doppler cells; no resampling of future scene or truth-based association.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.
theory.delta: asraam: thermal_image.v1; acquire_m=13000, gimbal_deg=45, sample_period_s=0.02, processing_delay_s=0.01, field_half_angle_rad=0.12, angle_noise_rad=0.0004, track_memory_s=0.12, ir_band_low_um=3, ir_band_high_um=5, receiver_pixel_pitch_rad=0.0015, receiver_psf_sigma_rad=0.00075, receiver_integration_s=1e-05, receiver_aperture_area_m2=0.0013526519869112555, receiver_quantum_efficiency=0.6. Exact card variant and its own mass, charge, sensor and timing records are used. Shared code neither supplies undisclosed OEM internals nor establishes equipment equivalence.

theory.equations: M=(1-s)*(W-C); D=ratio*missileD; L=(C/rhoC+M/rhoCase+s*(W-C)/rhoS)/(pi*(D/2)^2); v=1000*G/sqrt(M/C+1/2). V0 thin wall: t=M/(rhoCase*pi*D*max(L,.001)); N=round(M/(rhoCase*t^3)) for point fragments, or round(M/(rhoCase*t^2*L)) for rods; emitted scene mi=M/N. Zone selection is a mixture with uniform cosine inside each selected band, not uniform polar angle.
theory.states: One emitted field, stable source ordinals, material age, point/rod endpoint positions and velocities, connected-unfolding age until breakup, per-victim crossing history.
theory.inputs: This exact card charge/case/Gurney data, captured burst pose/velocity/spin and RNG; native moving target geometry/material/environment.
theory.outputs: Finite point/rod population, remaining energy/momentum, skin/component work and source-attributed native damage; no hit probability scalar.
theory.discretization: Integer equivalent fragment count; rigid captured source transform; native chronological material crossings and continuation. Angular zones overlap where authored. Spatial/temporal convergence is separate from parameter calibration.
theory.limits: Equivalent homogeneous case/rods; no explosive hydrocode or measured fragment arena. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Whole phase-zero reticle scans; midpoint measurement epoch, read-ready after scan end plus processing delay. One resolved bearing never grants LOS rate.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

theory.equations: r(u)=r0+u*(r1-r0); u0=-(r0.d)/(d.d). Restrict to armed live [armingS,lifeS); evaluate norm(r(u)). V0 accepts the constrained minimum, including an approaching endpoint; this is not an actual-turn requirement.

sensitivity.effect: Radius uncertainty can flip the discrete decision; no smooth probability claim.
Timing and body-station uncertainty must be assessed with actual captured closing motion, not a scene-specific radius fit.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: All23 swept-path cards share a software law, not sensor hardware; individual radius/lifetime and own release/target histories remain distinct.
Time-armed geometric scene admits no RF/optical discrimination: a physically eligible decoy can trigger it.
V0 endpoint minimum differs materially from V1 actual-turn initiation; equal radius does not make AIM120D and AIM120C equivalent.
Capture gaps, removed-target cutoffs, arming/expiry tangencies and fixed-delay missing pose can prevent valid initiation; absence of a burst is not automatically a warhead failure.

theory.states: One emitted field, stable source ordinals, material age, point/rod endpoint positions and velocities, connected-unfolding age until breakup, per-victim crossing history.
theory.inputs: This exact card charge/case/Gurney data, captured burst pose/velocity/spin and RNG; native moving target geometry/material/environment.
theory.outputs: Finite point/rod population, remaining energy/momentum, skin/component work and source-attributed native damage; no hit probability scalar.
theory.discretization: Integer equivalent fragment count; rigid captured source transform; native chronological material crossings and continuation. Angular zones overlap where authored. Spatial/temporal convergence is separate from parameter calibration.
theory.limits: Equivalent homogeneous case/rods; no explosive hydrocode or measured fragment arena. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

theory.equations: L_lambda=epsilon*2*h*c^2/(lambda^5*expm1(h*c/(lambda*k*T))); Q=integral(Lband*dOmega)*A*t*tau*QE*lambda_eff/(h*c). Two finite image channels with their own charge/noise state and measured spectral pairing; unavailable passive range is never supplied.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Finite detector/exposure or range/Doppler cells; no resampling of future scene or truth-based association.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.
theory.delta: mica-ir: thermal_dual_image.v1; acquire_m=13000, gimbal_deg=45, sample_period_s=0.02, processing_delay_s=0.01, field_half_angle_rad=0.12, angle_noise_rad=0.0004, track_memory_s=0.12, ir_band_low_um=3, ir_band_high_um=5, receiver_pixel_pitch_rad=0.0015, receiver_psf_sigma_rad=0.00075, receiver_integration_s=1e-05, receiver_aperture_area_m2=0.0012566370614359172, receiver_quantum_efficiency=0.6. The actual receiver is dual-band imaging with separate channel and pairing policies, not the single-band or scalar-reticle receiver. Second actual band8–12um, effective photon wavelength10um, separate QE0.6/exposure10us/channel state; spectral pairing is a distinct gate.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: Exact selected receiver binding matters: old thermal_quadrant.v1 compatibility results do not verify thermal_conscan_reticle.v1.

Reticle mask, scalar capacitance/noise-area inference, stop/scan radius and scan law are engineering assumptions for these AAM variants, including Magic2 with a different historical multi-element description.
MICAIR dual-band discrimination and imaging clutter association require their own parameterized actual outputs; one common Planck equation pass is insufficient.

Navigation/measurement epoch error, eclipse, false image/waveform fits, clutter/flare contamination and unresolved angular rates can break the coupled chain despite correct static photon/RF arithmetic.

derived_geometry.source_geometry: finite sampled annulus in scene emitter; exact inner radius for V2, thin-wall inferred inner radius for V0

theory.equations: M=(1-s)*(W-C); D=ratio*missileD; L=(C/rhoC+M/rhoCase+s*(W-C)/rhoS)/(pi*(D/2)^2); v=1000*G/sqrt(M/C+1/2). V0 thin wall: t=M/(rhoCase*pi*D*max(L,.001)); N=round(M/(rhoCase*t^3)) for point fragments, or round(M/(rhoCase*t^2*L)) for rods; emitted scene mi=M/N. Zone selection is a mixture with uniform cosine inside each selected band, not uniform polar angle.
theory.states: One emitted field, stable source ordinals, material age, point/rod endpoint positions and velocities, connected-unfolding age until breakup, per-victim crossing history.
theory.inputs: This exact card charge/case/Gurney data, captured burst pose/velocity/spin and RNG; native moving target geometry/material/environment.
theory.outputs: Finite point/rod population, remaining energy/momentum, skin/component work and source-attributed native damage; no hit probability scalar.
theory.discretization: Integer equivalent fragment count; rigid captured source transform; native chronological material crossings and continuation. Angular zones overlap where authored. Spatial/temporal convergence is separate from parameter calibration.
theory.limits: Equivalent homogeneous case/rods; no explosive hydrocode or measured fragment arena. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.
theory.delta: pl-12: W=20kg,C=9.2kg,M=9.18kg,D=0.1827m,L=0.273265038m,t=0.00745590788m,N=2821,v=2124.43111m/s; Exact card variant and its own mass, charge, sensor and timing records are used. Shared code neither supplies undisclosed OEM internals nor establishes equipment equivalence.

parameter_matrix.correlations: Original per-parameter screening uncertainties are retained; covariance/correlation and equipment confidence coverage are unknown, so no independent-error aggregation is claimed.
parameter_matrix.identical_policy_meaning: No other current model in this family has this complete numeric policy and mechanism/receiver binding.
parameter_matrix.active_binding_note: All referenced records are preserved for exact descriptor hashing; retained scalar/compatibility roles do not establish additional active hardware. The selected receiver/mechanism bindings determine which numerical paths execute.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: M=(1-s)*(W-C); D=ratio*missileD; L=(C/rhoC+M/rhoCase+s*(W-C)/rhoS)/(pi*(D/2)^2); v=1000*G/sqrt(M/C+1/2). V0 thin wall: t=M/(rhoCase*pi*D*max(L,.001)); N=round(M/(rhoCase*t^3)) for point fragments, or round(M/(rhoCase*t^2*L)) for rods; emitted scene mi=M/N. Zone selection is a mixture with uniform cosine inside each selected band, not uniform polar angle.
assumptions_and_theory_gap: Case partition15%, diameter90%, steel density and equivalent shape are generic assumptions for V0; descriptor refs do not expose these as per-model measured inputs.
V2 finite station/densities/Cd and seven angular shares are explicit, with game-reference zones and inferred geometry; not a measured C7 fragment distribution.
THOR steel-fragment/2024-T3 plate law is not DU/titanium/composite physics; connected topology is selected only by connected_ring.v1.
Blast TNT equivalence differs from fragment-driving energy; legacy equivalence is inferred from Gurney, V2 has a separate explicit TNT record.
fidelity_matrix.model_specific_gap: Exact card variant and its own mass, charge, sensor and timing records are used. Shared code neither supplies undisclosed OEM internals nor establishes equipment equivalence.
fidelity_matrix.validated_current_scope: Static current parameter/source mapping and written derivations only.

method.case: Actual selected AAM effects methods expose primary-reference observations
method.historical_scope: Historical method data are retained only in the family historical_evidence; they do not pass the current source/card epoch.

shared_equivalence.scope: Only the exact stated equations/software branch; each model retains full own parameter records and requires distinct actual execution.
shared_equivalence.limits: Not OEM hardware equivalence, common calibration, or replacement of a model-specific native/public/visual outcome.

rows.angular_zones_source_usage: The scene emitter samples the listed mixture uniformly in cosine within each chosen band.

thor.domain: Existing steel-fragment/2024-T3 empirical fit. Original experimental parameter envelope not newly revalidated; no extension to DU/composites/titanium.

blast.fit: Swisdak1994 simplified Kingery hemispherical fit; SDK free-air approximation uses half charge

material_laws.source_geometry_distinction: World scene emitter uses finite sampled shell and M/N; retained synchronous V0 assessor uses point-source legacy zones and nominal pre-round fragment mass.

descriptor.note: Explicit native focal-plane/quadrant or aperture/waveform receiver before association; epoch-aligned own strapdown pose reconstructs measured LOS. Scene signatures and detector constants are disclosed engineering assumptions, not hardware calibration.
descriptor.validity: Radiometric engineering receiver v1; nonzero uncertainty is an unvalidated screening interval, not fitted hardware calibration. Scene time quantization is bounded by the World decision step.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: M=(1-s)*(W-C); D=ratio*missileD; L=(C/rhoC+M/rhoCase+s*(W-C)/rhoS)/(pi*(D/2)^2); v=1000*G/sqrt(M/C+1/2). V0 thin wall: t=M/(rhoCase*pi*D*max(L,.001)); N=round(M/(rhoCase*t^3)) for point fragments, or round(M/(rhoCase*t^2*L)) for rods; emitted scene mi=M/N. Zone selection is a mixture with uniform cosine inside each selected band, not uniform polar angle.
assumptions_and_theory_gap: Case partition15%, diameter90%, steel density and equivalent shape are generic assumptions for V0; descriptor refs do not expose these as per-model measured inputs.
V2 finite station/densities/Cd and seven angular shares are explicit, with game-reference zones and inferred geometry; not a measured C7 fragment distribution.
THOR steel-fragment/2024-T3 plate law is not DU/titanium/composite physics; connected topology is selected only by connected_ring.v1.
Blast TNT equivalence differs from fragment-driving energy; legacy equivalence is inferred from Gurney, V2 has a separate explicit TNT record.

parameter_matrix.correlations: Original per-parameter screening uncertainties are retained; covariance/correlation and equipment confidence coverage are unknown, so no independent-error aggregation is claimed.
parameter_matrix.identical_policy_meaning: These models currently reuse the same numerical engineering policy; that equality does not establish identical hardware, separate equipment tuning or calibrated per-model fidelity.
parameter_matrix.active_binding_note: All referenced records are preserved for exact descriptor hashing; retained scalar/compatibility roles do not establish additional active hardware. The selected receiver/mechanism bindings determine which numerical paths execute.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: M=(1-s)*(W-C); D=ratio*missileD; L=(C/rhoC+M/rhoCase+s*(W-C)/rhoS)/(pi*(D/2)^2); v=1000*G/sqrt(M/C+1/2). V0 thin wall: t=M/(rhoCase*pi*D*max(L,.001)); N=round(M/(rhoCase*t^3)) for point fragments, or round(M/(rhoCase*t^2*L)) for rods; emitted scene mi=M/N. Connected polygon: Rmax=N*L/(2*pi), tb=(Rmax-ro)/min(v,1400), Ki=mi*(v0.v0+v0.v1+v1.v1)/6.

sensitivity.domain: Only while uncapped speed remains strictly above1400m/s. The transition is nonsmooth; uncertainty crossing the cap requires piecewise reevaluation.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: Case partition15%, diameter90%, steel density and equivalent shape are generic assumptions for V0; descriptor refs do not expose these as per-model measured inputs.
V2 finite station/densities/Cd and seven angular shares are explicit, with game-reference zones and inferred geometry; not a measured C7 fragment distribution.
THOR steel-fragment/2024-T3 plate law is not DU/titanium/composite physics; connected topology is selected only by connected_ring.v1.
Blast TNT equivalence differs from fragment-driving energy; legacy equivalence is inferred from Gurney, V2 has a separate explicit TNT record.
fidelity_matrix.model_specific_gap: Exact card variant and its own mass, charge, sensor and timing records are used. Shared code neither supplies undisclosed OEM internals nor establishes equipment equivalence.
fidelity_matrix.validated_current_scope: Static current parameter/source mapping and written derivations only.
not_validated: Fresh native method comparisons for current hashes
Actual full-chain success for this model under current source
Installed/public and full visual gates
Equipment-specific holdout calibration
fidelity_matrix.failure_modes: Equivalent homogeneous case/rods; no explosive hydrocode or measured fragment arena. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

method.case: Actual selected AAM effects methods expose primary-reference observations
method.historical_scope: Historical method data are retained only in the family historical_evidence; they do not pass the current source/card epoch.

shared_equivalence.scope: Only the exact stated equations/software branch; each model retains full own parameter records and requires distinct actual execution.
shared_equivalence.limits: Not OEM hardware equivalence, common calibration, or replacement of a model-specific native/public/visual outcome.

rows.angular_zones_source_usage: Retained model zones are not sampled by the connected polygon emitter.

thor.domain: Existing steel-fragment/2024-T3 empirical fit. Original experimental parameter envelope not newly revalidated; no extension to DU/composites/titanium.

blast.fit: Swisdak1994 simplified Kingery hemispherical fit; SDK free-air approximation uses half charge

material_laws.source_geometry_distinction: World scene emitter uses finite sampled shell and M/N; retained synchronous V0 assessor uses point-source legacy zones and nominal pre-round fragment mass.

descriptor.note: Explicit native focal-plane/quadrant or aperture/waveform receiver before association; epoch-aligned own strapdown pose reconstructs measured LOS. Scene signatures and detector constants are disclosed engineering assumptions, not hardware calibration.
descriptor.validity: Radiometric engineering receiver v1; nonzero uncertainty is an unvalidated screening interval, not fitted hardware calibration. Scene time quantization is bounded by the World decision step.

V0 thin wall: t=M/(rhoCase*pi*D*max(L,.001)); N=round(M/(rhoCase*t^3)) for point fragments, or round(M/(rhoCase*t^2*L)) for rods; emitted scene mi=M/N. Connected polygon: Rmax=N*L/(2*pi), tb=(Rmax-ro)/min(v,1400), Ki=mi*(v0.v0+v0.v1+v1.v1)/6.

sensitivity.domain: Only while uncapped speed remains strictly above1400m/s. The transition is nonsmooth; uncertainty crossing the cap requires piecewise reevaluation.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: Case partition15%, diameter90%, steel density and equivalent shape are generic assumptions for V0; descriptor refs do not expose these as per-model measured inputs.
V2 finite station/densities/Cd and seven angular shares are explicit, with game-reference zones and inferred geometry; not a measured C7 fragment distribution.
THOR steel-fragment/2024-T3 plate law is not DU/titanium/composite physics; connected topology is selected only by connected_ring.v1.
Blast TNT equivalence differs from fragment-driving energy; legacy equivalence is inferred from Gurney, V2 has a separate explicit TNT record.
fidelity_matrix.model_specific_gap: Exact card variant and its own mass, charge, sensor and timing records are used. Shared code neither supplies undisclosed OEM internals nor establishes equipment equivalence.
fidelity_matrix.validated_current_scope: Static current parameter/source mapping and written derivations only.
not_validated: Fresh native method comparisons for current hashes
Actual full-chain success for this model under current source
Installed/public and full visual gates
Equipment-specific holdout calibration
fidelity_matrix.failure_modes: Equivalent homogeneous case/rods; no explosive hydrocode or measured fragment arena. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

method.case: Actual selected AAM effects methods expose primary-reference observations
method.historical_scope: Historical method data are retained only in the family historical_evidence; they do not pass the current source/card epoch.

shared_equivalence.scope: Only the exact stated equations/software branch; each model retains full own parameter records and requires distinct actual execution.
shared_equivalence.limits: Not OEM hardware equivalence, common calibration, or replacement of a model-specific native/public/visual outcome.

rows.angular_zones_source_usage: Retained model zones are not sampled by the connected polygon emitter.

thor.domain: Existing steel-fragment/2024-T3 empirical fit. Original experimental parameter envelope not newly revalidated; no extension to DU/composites/titanium.

blast.fit: Swisdak1994 simplified Kingery hemispherical fit; SDK free-air approximation uses half charge

material_laws.source_geometry_distinction: World scene emitter uses finite sampled shell and M/N; retained synchronous V0 assessor uses point-source legacy zones and nominal pre-round fragment mass.

descriptor.note: Explicit native focal-plane/quadrant or aperture/waveform receiver before association; epoch-aligned own strapdown pose reconstructs measured LOS. Scene signatures and detector constants are disclosed engineering assumptions, not hardware calibration.
descriptor.validity: Radiometric engineering receiver v1; nonzero uncertainty is an unvalidated screening interval, not fitted hardware calibration. Scene time quantization is bounded by the World decision step.

V0 thin wall: t=M/(rhoCase*pi*D*max(L,.001)); N=round(M/(rhoCase*t^3)) for point fragments, or round(M/(rhoCase*t^2*L)) for rods; emitted scene mi=M/N. Discrete rod speed is capped at1400m/s; no connected topology is inferred.
theory.states: One emitted field, stable source ordinals, material age, point/rod endpoint positions and velocities, connected-unfolding age until breakup, per-victim crossing history.
theory.inputs: This exact card charge/case/Gurney data, captured burst pose/velocity/spin and RNG; native moving target geometry/material/environment.
theory.outputs: Finite point/rod population, remaining energy/momentum, skin/component work and source-attributed native damage; no hit probability scalar.
theory.discretization: Integer equivalent fragment count; rigid captured source transform; native chronological material crossings and continuation. Angular zones overlap where authored. Spatial/temporal convergence is separate from parameter calibration.
theory.limits: Equivalent homogeneous case/rods; no explosive hydrocode or measured fragment arena. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.
theory.delta: r-73: W=8kg,C=3.75kg,M=3.6125kg,D=0.1485m,L=0.167172285m,t=0.00590061928m,N=79,v=1400m/s; Rod description maps to discrete finite rod elements under zoned_case.v1, not connected_ring.v1; exact weld topology and material construction are not inferred.

primary_sources.scope: Uniform cylindrical case and linear radial gas velocity; energy per explosive mass. Finite zones and connected rods are separately identified engineering source extensions, not measured validation from Gurney.

V0 thin wall: t=M/(rhoCase*pi*D*max(L,.001)); N=round(M/(rhoCase*t^3)) for point fragments, or round(M/(rhoCase*t^2*L)) for rods; emitted scene mi=M/N. sensitivity.domain: Only while uncapped speed remains strictly above1400m/s. The transition is nonsmooth; uncertainty crossing the cap requires piecewise reevaluation.

assumptions_and_theory_gap: Case partition15%, diameter90%, steel density and equivalent shape are generic assumptions for V0; descriptor refs do not expose these as per-model measured inputs.
V2 finite station/densities/Cd and seven angular shares are explicit, with game-reference zones and inferred geometry; not a measured C7 fragment distribution.
THOR steel-fragment/2024-T3 plate law is not DU/titanium/composite physics; connected topology is selected only by connected_ring.v1.
Blast TNT equivalence differs from fragment-driving energy; legacy equivalence is inferred from Gurney, V2 has a separate explicit TNT record.
fidelity_matrix.model_specific_gap: Rod description maps to discrete finite rod elements under zoned_case.v1, not connected_ring.v1; exact weld topology and material construction are not inferred.
fidelity_matrix.validated_current_scope: Static current parameter/source mapping and written derivations only.

method.case: Actual selected AAM effects methods expose primary-reference observations
method.historical_scope: Historical method data are retained only in the family historical_evidence; they do not pass the current source/card epoch.

shared_equivalence.scope: Only the exact stated equations/software branch; each model retains full own parameter records and requires distinct actual execution.
shared_equivalence.limits: Not OEM hardware equivalence, common calibration, or replacement of a model-specific native/public/visual outcome.

rows.angular_zones_source_usage: The scene emitter samples the listed mixture uniformly in cosine within each chosen band.

thor.domain: Existing steel-fragment/2024-T3 empirical fit. Original experimental parameter envelope not newly revalidated; no extension to DU/composites/titanium.

blast.fit: Swisdak1994 simplified Kingery hemispherical fit; SDK free-air approximation uses half charge

material_laws.source_geometry_distinction: World scene emitter uses finite sampled shell and M/N; retained synchronous V0 assessor uses point-source legacy zones and nominal pre-round fragment mass.

descriptor.note: Explicit native focal-plane/quadrant or aperture/waveform receiver before association; epoch-aligned own strapdown pose reconstructs measured LOS. Scene signatures and detector constants are disclosed engineering assumptions, not hardware calibration.
descriptor.validity: Radiometric engineering receiver v1; nonzero uncertainty is an unvalidated screening interval, not fitted hardware calibration. Scene time quantization is bounded by the World decision step.

theory.equations: Pr=Pt*Gt/(4*pi*Rt^2)*sigma/(4*pi*Rr^2)*Gr*lambda^2/(4*pi*L); coherent energy SNR=Pr*t/(k*T*F). Finite aperture Fourier gain, physical range/Doppler bins, CFAR and temporal association. SARH additionally requires actual separate illumination and pulse/PRF coincidence.
theory.states: Gimbal/search pose and dynamics, exposure phase/history, processing queue, receiver RNG/detector or RF state, local measured association and track/navigation memory.
theory.inputs: This card resolved detector/optics/RF parameters, finite scene radiance or echoes/clutter, captured own optical/navigation epochs, permitted launcher delivery separately, component RNG.
theory.outputs: Observed bearing/validity/covariance and original measurement/receive epochs; rate only from resolved information; measured range only for supported RF channels. Referee source IDs are attribution after detection.
theory.discretization: Actual sample period/processing delay/gimbal/track lag and memory. Finite detector/exposure or range/Doppler cells; no resampling of future scene or truth-based association.
theory.limits: Grey radiators, finite supports, assumed signatures/noise/PSF/clutter and geometric optical path; no admitted equipment Pd/Pfa/IRCCM calibration. Current source/card hashes establish the described implementation only. New native/method comparison, coupled-chain, installed/public, visual and separate equipment-calibration gates are not admitted by this document.

fidelity_matrix.implemented: Pr=Pt*Gt/(4*pi*Rt^2)*sigma/(4*pi*Rr^2)*Gr*lambda^2/(4*pi*L); coherent energy SNR=Pr*t/(k*T*F). Finite aperture Fourier gain, physical range/Doppler bins, CFAR and temporal association. SARH additionally requires actual separate illumination and pulse/PRF coincidence.

sensitivity.limit: Resolved finite patches use actual solid angle, not an unconditional inverse-square shortcut.

Navigation/measurement epoch error, eclipse, false image/waveform fits, clutter/flare contamination and unresolved angular rates can break the coupled chain despite correct static photon/RF arithmetic.
